author: Ronald Murchison
text: When I had that happen, if I had less than 5 days left, I switched it out. I didn't bother with a replacement.

author: Juli Pierson Holstein
text: Call their customer service or service on their website page.  They will replace it. If you call they should ask if you have a backup and if you don't they will expedite delivery.  If you have another one.  Put it on dont go without.  They are good about replacing though
